exposure: Previous cesarean delivery (number of previous cesarean deliveries)
cohort: 120 pregnant women at 36 to 38 weeks gestation, with 60 having one or more previous cesarean deliveries and 60 having no history of cesarean delivery.
finding: The lower uterine segment was significantly thinner in women with previous cesarean deliveries compared to women with unscarred uteruses, with progressive thinning observed with an increased number of cesarean deliveries.
